scenarios.title: Equip v2: one tap on a Vault helm while another is worn: worn within seconds in the field or town, the old helm is a Vault record, nothing dropped
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only) as vault.equip-set10, plus the PLAYER-ORDERED direct equip writes of ADR 0029 (amended 2026-11-25): an unmeasured real-time run (the fork refuses the verbs under --lockstep), so `writes after start` is the number of equip orders, not 0. Not evidence about balance or parity.
scenarios.notes: Equip v2 (card equipv2). RED on the old flow: loot.vaultEquip is 0 here, so the order flow refuses (409 off) and nothing is worn; GREEN needs the devp29 binary (PG_D2D_BIN=/data/d2d-lab/qdbin/d2d-devp29-directequip). The timer is the log window (coarse: the virtual minute is a linear map of wall time, U).

assert.pattern: equip: .* worn in head, .* went to the vault
assert.why: worn and the old helm vaulted inside the first half virtual minute (the old flow waits for a town stop)
the old helm is a vault record
